Hi {{NAME}}, glad you're in! Here's how to get started:

1. Install
Open this link on your phone:
{{JOIN_URL}}
Important: The Play Store needs to be signed in with {{GOOGLE_EMAIL}} (tap your profile picture in the top right to switch accounts).
Tap “Become a tester”, then install the app from the Play Store like any other app. Don't be surprised: it may still be listed as “com.hummlist.app”, and the Install button can take a few minutes to show up. Updates come automatically after that.

2. Sign in
With Google, email and password, or a sign-in link. Whether the app may collect anonymous usage data is your call; your list is never sent for it.

3. Household
One of you creates a household and invites the other by link or code. The invite is good for 7 days and works once.

Your task: Put your next grocery run on the list and take it to the store.
My question: What bugged you on that first trip?

If installing gets stuck, we'll set it up together.

Peter
